Your pontoon paid 2:1 on the 100 stake, so you won 200 and got your stake back. Bankroll is 1,300. You Buy a card. Your round is settled: pontoon beat the dealer's 16, so you won 200. Your bankroll is 1,300. There's no live hand, so there's nothing to buy right now. Place a new stake and deal, and Buy will be available once your cards are out. You Stick. Your pontoon round is settled. You held pontoon against the dealer's 16, so you won 200 at 2:1. Your bankroll is 1,300. There's no live hand, so there's nothing to stick on or buy. Press Deal again and set a stake to play the next round. Bankroll is 1,300. Place your next stake to deal the next round.
